to fix this issue to some extent they should at-least let players wear the avatars from their collection tru the vrchat website 
Just like the “set to default avatar next time you join the game” option because this issue has been going on for a while or different varieties of the issue but their the same issue in the end

help the only people in those damn threads that had the problem fixed would comment that it went away on its own after some days or a week but ive been playing the whole day and nothing happened
